name: S2.3 test automation golden set
description: Build Bible §22 evaluation dataset, v1: approved test cases over the sample repositories, each paired with a golden automation output — a competent model's reference answer in the test-automator@1 output contract (single-line JSON metadata + one fenced code block), validated by the §21 GeneratedTest schema. Consumed by the S2.3 unit tests (fake model = golden model_output) and the S2.3 live eval (real local LLM), which scores every output: schema + convention expectations + real tsc --strict / ESLint. Exit gate per §19 S2.3: lint + type pass fraction ≥ 95%. v1 scope is JS/TS fixtures: the §21 gate runs the workspace tsc/ESLint toolchain over @playwright/test-stubbed specs (see tests/unit/support/playwright-test).

test_case.title: Counter increments once per click
preconditions: The js-web-app dev server is running at http://localhost:5173
steps: Click the counter button three times
expected_results: The counter button reads "Count: 1" after the first click
The counter button reads "Count: 3" after the third click

test_case.title: Counter starts at zero before any interaction
preconditions: The js-web-app dev server is running at http://localhost:5173
No interaction with the counter has occurred
steps: Read the counter button without clicking it
expected_results: The counter button reads "Count: 0" on first load
